questions.q: What does 'that we may know them' mean in Genesis 19:5?
questions.explain: To know in scripture is to lie with: Rebekah was a virgin, neither had any man known her (Genesis 24:16).

questions.q: What does Genesis 19 show about sodomy before the law at Sinai?
choices: It was already wickedness and unlawful
It was only a custom of Egypt
questions.explain: Lot said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly. This is way before Leviticus 18.

questions.q: Why did the angel tell Lot, 'I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither'?
choices: The destruction waited on the righteous being brought out
questions.explain: The same way the angels in Revelation 7 hold the four winds until the servants of God are sealed.

questions.q: What is the pillar of salt that Lot's wife became?
choices: A standing monument of an unbelieving soul
questions.explain: Remember Lot's wife (Luke 17:32). If you find yourself reminiscing after the old life, remember Lot's wife.

questions.q: Which nations came from Lot's daughters?
questions.explain: The firstborn bare Moab, the younger Benammi, father of the Ammonites. Uncovering a father's nakedness is against the law (Leviticus 18:7).
